hooks.command: echo 'IMPORTANT: If you notice that LKG MCP tools appear with BOTH a plugin prefix (e.g. mcp__plugin_lkg_lkg__codebase_search) AND a standalone prefix (e.g. mcp__lkg__codebase_search), the user has a duplicate configuration. Advise them to remove the standalone MCP by running: claude mcp remove lkg - the plugin already provides the MCP server key `lkg` via @openagentland/lkg.'
